limits.head: Single turn only
limits.body: One request in, one set of calls out. No conversation memory.

limits.head: No planning
limits.body: In the arena a planner says what to do. The model turns it into the call; it does not plan.

limits.head: CPU is the weak spot
limits.body: 0.45 s per call on 8 server cores, several seconds on a laptop. The speed story is a GPU story.

limits.head: Research preview
limits.body: Trained on xLAM-60k, a research-only dataset. The weights follow that licence.
